evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction creation logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an on-chain privacy leak where RBF replacements can backdate nLockTime relative to the original transaction. As the wallet guide highlights transaction creation privacy and fingerprinting as high priority, eliminating this unnatural on-chain fingerprint affecting hundreds of weekly transactions provides meaningful privacy value.
